name: Name tag: split page
when: A character's first strong appearance. A page slides over the left of the frame and the name and role are set on it; the shot stays full size beside it (it moves right only if the page would cover the face). Works on dark shots. No ground needed.
anchor: The scene starts on the character's name: the page slides in from frame 6, the name rises from frame 16.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.shot: the clip of the person: the same shot as the footage at this moment, cut to the scene's length, in the project's assets/
vars.name1: the name's first line (shown in capitals), 8 characters at most
vars.name2: the name's second line, 8 characters at most; empty = one line
vars.role1: the role's first line, 28 characters at most; empty = no role
vars.role2: the role's second line, 28 characters at most; empty = one line
vars.faceX: the centre of the face, x in px on the 1920x1080 shot: the shot moves right so the face stays 300 px clear of the page. 80 px off still works
vars.faceY: the centre of the face, y in px
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave; the shot is full frame again 0.4 s later and the scene ends on it at 0.43 s (default: scene length - 0.43)
